name: thermal-fluid-research-workflow
description: Modular thermal-fluid research skills for analysis, writing, proposals, data, slides, mentoring, and manuscript revision.

interface.shortDescription: Focused thermal-fluid research skills plus a cross-cutting rigor layer.
interface.longDescription: A modular workflow plugin for thermal-fluid mechanical engineering research. Use focused skills for thermal-fluid analysis, research writing and literature, proposal development, data analysis, slide design, and constructive mentor review; use the reviewer-author loop for iterative peer review, revision, verification, rebuttal, and acceptance or pause decisions. The mechanical-engineering-research skill coordinates cross-cutting work and preserves evidence and validity checks.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this heat-transfer correlation is valid for my regime.
Review this CFD setup and identify unsupported claims.
Design an experiment plan with uncertainty and calibration checks.
Review this figure and explain the physics.
Give actionable mentor feedback on this student research draft.
